rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns of Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        tlp = "amber"
        reference = "ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 2E 63 73 72 63 } // '.rcd.cs' artifact
        $c2_http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
